attempt: Represent a leaf heap using overlapping horizontal cutout sheets, then close it with a coarse opaque filler without matching visible texture detail or a gradual base.
reason_failed: The user observed see-through gaps between layers. The first opaque pilot removed holes but exposed shelves/coarse pixels and hid individual leaf identity. Later feedback identified an abrupt mound-to-ground junction. Bounds and asset validity alone did not establish acceptable appearance.
environment: Windows, Hytale 0.7.2, Blockbench native hytale_prop; installed pile baseline 1.13.0 and discarded 1.13.1 pilots.
error_signature: Floating horizontal tiers; chunky surface pixels; abrupt base despite correct overall dimensions.
conditions: Thin alpha-cutout carriers used as a volumetric pile
Low-angle appearance not captured by a single oblique preview
Low-resolution texture exposed directly on a filled surface
workaround: Continuous filled sloping surface, finer pile-only leaf texture, exterior leaf cards, flared lower profile, circular ground carpet and lower-half overlays. Native views pass; final client visual acceptance pending.

sources.description: Installed 1.13.1 pile visual revision; native asset checks, feedback scope, unchanged Java proof and final client acceptance limitation.
